mon:
cat > /root/collect.py <<'PYEOF'
import socket
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
s.bind(("0.0.0.0", 514))
f = open("/root/syslog.log", "ab", 0)
while True:
    f.write(s.recvfrom(2048)[0] + b"\n")
PYEOF
